Regarding the security issues in the provided text, the primary vulnerability identified is the hard-coding of API keys within the mobile app's backend services. This practice creates a significant data storage and access vulnerability because the credentials are embedded directly in the source code. Since the code is publicly accessible via repositories, these API keys are exposed to unauthorized parties. This exposure allows attackers to gain illicit access to the cloud-hosted backend services, compromising the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the data managed by those services.
